Drive Mad is a physics-based driving and stunt web and mobile game created by Martin Magni and built on Fancade mechanics. 
Poki
Game Overview
Objective: Drive unique, weird vehicles across obstacle courses and reach the finish line without flipping over or crashing.
Mechanics: Balance and timing matter more than speed. Accelerating tilts the car forward, while braking tilts it backward, which you must use to control jumps and slopes.
Content: Features hundreds of handcrafted levels split across multiple worlds (including Classic, Winter, and Monster Truck worlds).
Platforms: Available to play free in web browsers on sites like Poki, as well as on mobile app stores for Android and iOS.
